description: Dummy Doctor: a placeholder type of the Otherworld Alchemilla Hospital. Its map group slot exists (map3_s04), but the original never spawns it and gives it only CHARA/DUMMY.ILM, a 256-byte model of one triangle with no texture; the Puppet Doctor's AI would drive it. Not spawnable.

spawn.note: unused placeholder of the original: its only model is CHARA/DUMMY.ILM (one triangle, no texture)
